steps.eval: (()=>{const g=__game; const out=[]; for(const id of ['E2','E3','E4','E5','E6','E2']){ g.loadRound(id); g.showScreen(null); g.mode='play'; g.player.release(); const xs=[0.2,0.5,0.8].map(f=>g.course.finishX*f); let tot=0,n=0,calls=0,tris=0; for(const fx of xs){ let d=g.course.supportAt(fx,0); let x=fx; while(!d){x-=0.5; d=g.course.supportAt(x,0);} g.player.respawn({x,y:d.topAt(x)}); g.cam.snap(g.player,g.course); for(let k=0;k<10;k++){ if(k<4){ g.render(1/60); g.renderer.getContext().finish(); continue; } const t0=performance.now(); g.simulate(1/60,()=>({move:1})); g.visuals(1/60); g.render(1/60); g.renderer.getContext().finish(); tot+=performance.now()-t0; n++; } calls+=g.renderer.info.render.calls; tris+=g.renderer.info.render.triangles; } out.push(id+': '+(tot/n).toFixed(0)+' ms/frame (swiftshader), draws '+(calls/3).toFixed(0)+', tris '+(tris/3000).toFixed(0)+'k'); } return out})()
